description_target.target_text: Exterior pixels shoot rays into diamond interior, stopping at interior pixels (obstacles)

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A red(2) rectangle outline holds a few interior pixels; loose
 ;; EXTERIOR pixels shoot into the box along their row or column,
 ;; painting their color from just inside the near wall up to (but not
 ;; through) the first interior pixel — or the far wall.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (row-span r)  ;; (left right) red walls of the row
       (let ((cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 w))))
         (and (>= (length cs) 2) (list (min-list cs) (max-list cs)))))
     (define (col-span c)
       (let ((rs (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range 0 h))))
         (and (>= (length rs) 2) (list (min-list rs) (max-list rs)))))
     (define (pixel? r c)
       (let ((v (at g r c)))
         (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)))))
     (define (interior? r c)
       (let ((sp (row-span r)))
         (and sp (< (first sp) c) (< c (second sp)))))
     (define (interior-pixel? p)
       (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
            (interior? (first p) (second p))))
     (define (ray from to step pos-of)  ;; stop at wall or a pixel
       (let loop ((x from) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((if (> step 0) (>= x to) (<= x to)) (reverse acc))
               ((interior-pixel? (pos-of x)) (reverse acc))
               (else (loop (+ x step) (cons (pos-of x) acc))))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((p (filter (lambda (p)
                             (and (pixel? (first p) (second p))
                                  (not (interior? (first p)
                                                  (second p)))))
                           (grid-positions g))))
       (let* ((er (first p)) (ec (second p)) (ev (at g er ec))
              (cs (col-span ec))
              (rs (row-span er)))
         (cond (cs (cond ((< er (first cs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (+ (first cs) 1)
                                            (second cs) 1
                                            (lambda (r) (list r ec)))
                                       ev))
                         ((> er (second cs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (- (second cs) 1)
                                            (first cs) -1
                                            (lambda (r) (list r ec)))
                                       ev))
                         (else out)))
               (rs (cond ((< ec (first rs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (+ (first rs) 1)
                                            (second rs) 1
                                            (lambda (c) (list er c)))
                                       ev))
                         ((> ec (second rs))
                          (paint-cells out
                                       (ray (- (second rs) 1)
                                            (first rs) -1
                                            (lambda (c) (list er c)))
                                       ev))
                         (else out)))
               (else out)))))))
